name: Jamworks
description_en:
Jamworks is a lecture-focused capture and study system. It combines recordings and transcripts with slides, highlights, enhanced notes, flashcards and a course-aware AI tutor. The documented sequence is preparation before class, capture during class and revision afterwards.

It serves students and institution administrators through different onboarding paths. A trial or an institution-provided licence should be distinguished from an independently available perpetual free student plan.
description_zh:
Jamworks 是围绕课堂记录与学习设计的系统，把录音、转录与课件、高亮、增强笔记、闪卡和基于课程内容的 AI 导师结合起来。文档的顺序是课前准备、课中记录和课后复习。

学生与机构管理员有不同入门路径。试用或机构提供的许可，应与个人可持续使用的永久免费学生方案区分。

core_features.explanation_en: Record/transcribe lectures and mark important moments alongside slides.
core_features.explanation_zh: 录制／转录课堂，在课件旁标记重点时刻。

core_features.explanation_en: Enhanced notes, quizzes and highlight-linked flashcards support revision.
core_features.explanation_zh: 增强笔记、测验与关联高亮的闪卡辅助复习。

core_features.explanation_en: JamAI answers questions across course material; generated answers require checking.
core_features.explanation_zh: JamAI 可对课程资料问答，生成答案仍需核对。

en: Connect lecture recordings with slides and revision cards.
zh: 连接课堂录音、课件和复习卡片。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor desktop/mobile study service; institution access is separately arranged.
Deployment.zh: 厂商桌面／移动学习服务；机构访问单独安排。

steps.en: Check institution access and choose the student onboarding path.
steps.zh: 确认机构权限并选择学生入门路径。

steps.en: Upload a permitted slide set, capture a short sample and mark a highlight.
steps.zh: 上传获允许的课件，记录简短样例并标记高亮。

steps.en: Compare enhanced notes and flashcards with the source before using them for revision.
steps.zh: 复习前把增强笔记和闪卡与来源核对。

items.en: Jamworks merits evaluation when slides, spoken explanations and later revision need to stay connected. A general meeting-minute editor may be sufficient for decisions without teaching content. Start with the student onboarding route, confirm whether an institution already provides access, and check recording rules before uploading material. Preserve source slides and audio so a missing or incorrect AI section can be corrected manually. No recovery SLA, complete export route, self-hosted edition or open-source licence was verified.
items.zh: 需要把课件、口头讲解与后续复习关联时，Jamworks 值得评估。若只是记录决策而没有教学资料，通用会议纪要编辑器可能已足够。先走学生入门路径，确认机构是否已经提供权限，上传前核对课堂录制规则。建议保留课件和音频，便于人工纠正缺失或错误的 AI 内容。未核实恢复 SLA、完整导出途径、自行部署版或开源许可。

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: Prepare, capture and revise one lecture
sections.title_zh: 准备、记录并复习一堂课
sections.en: An illustrative workflow imports the reading or slide PDF before class, records the permitted lecture and marks important moments while taking rough notes. Afterwards, compare suggested note improvements with the recording and slides, then revise using highlight-linked flashcards. JamAI can answer questions across the course library; the vendor describes lesson-grounded tutoring, not a substitute for checking a derivation against course material.
sections.zh: 示例流程是课前导入阅读资料或课件 PDF，在获允许后录制课堂，边记简略笔记边标记重点。课后把建议补充的笔记与录音、课件核对，再用关联高亮的闪卡复习。JamAI 可针对课程库问答；厂商描述的是以课程为依据的辅导，不能替代对照课程材料检查推导。

sections.title_en: Learning aids and accessibility have different jobs
sections.title_zh: 学习辅助与无障碍各有职责
sections.en: The feature descriptions separate transcription/live captions, key points, enhanced notes, STEM equation presentation, quizzes and a personal tutor. The site also describes screen-reader/VoiceOver support and accessibility adjustments. Those are documented capabilities, not a measured improvement in grades or accessibility certification by this catalog. Test a difficult equation, an unclear recording and the actual assistive setup before using generated study material as the sole record.
sections.zh: 功能说明区分转录／实时字幕、要点、增强笔记、STEM 公式展示、测验和个人导师。官网还说明了屏幕阅读器／VoiceOver 支持与无障碍调整。这些是文档能力，不代表目录测量过成绩提升或进行了无障碍认证。建议先测试复杂公式、含糊录音与实际辅助设备配置，再决定是否依赖生成学习资料。

sections.en: The retrieved GBP student-pricing view shows £14.99 per month beside monthly/annual controls and an annual-saving statement. The selected billing cadence and annual payable total are not unambiguous in the extraction, so this is a displayed amount rather than a normalised quote. The 14-day trial requires payment details and says cancel anytime. Institution pricing is by request with a semester trial advertised. No perpetual free personal plan was verified.
sections.zh: 读取的英镑学生定价页在按月／按年选择器和年度优惠说明旁显示每月 14.99 英镑。提取内容未明确选中账期与实际年费，因此这是显示金额而非标准化报价。14 天试用需要付款信息，页面注明可随时取消。机构方案需询价，并宣传学期试用。未核实永久免费的个人方案。

sections.title_zh: 课堂辅助与通用团队纪要的边界

research_gaps.en: Exact annual charge, institutional entitlement, export/recovery, equation accuracy and assistive-device behaviour remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 确切年费、机构权益、导出／恢复、公式准确率和辅助设备行为尚未核实。

content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research; original English synthesis with matching Chinese sections. Workflow examples and evaluation advice were not executed.
